statements.markdown: The archive proves the statement from a mean-square estimate over prime moduli (meanSqK) and 1 a zero-density estimate (zero_density_box) for zeros with Re s > 1 − 400 , in the tradition of Bombieri [Bom65]; compare [Sie35b; Pag35] for the exceptional real zero that the second clause excludes.

lean.name: QH.meanSqK
lean.note: meanSqK.lean:51–54 states the mean-square result over primes in the admissible progression on [Y,Y^K]. StagePow.lean:49–54 uses it inside the argument that selects good prime pairs. This is the mean-square statement on a power window under the stated conditions on the moduli.

lean.name: Formalism.HermitianLattices.Ext.PrimitiveCharacterCasts.ZD.zero_density_box
lean.plain: A zero-density estimate across prime moduli
lean.note: CountZAll.lean:13–15 proves a count of primitive characters of modulus at most Q with a zero in Re(s) > 1 − 1/400, |Im(s)| ≤ Q. CountBadCore.lean:18–24 uses it in selecting the prime pairs. This declaration proves the named zero-density bound used in the exposition.
